description_en: Pushes speech corpora to a device
kebab_example: aliyun iot push-speech --push-mode SINGLE_DEVICE --project-code 4de2c36700008c585e599200 --speech-code-list example-string --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: PushSpeech

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID. You can view the ID of the current instance on the Overview tab of the IoT Platform console.

<notice>
If an ID value is available, you must specify this ID value. Otherwise, the call fails.
If no ID value is available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

</notice>

For more information about instances, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页签，查看当前实例的ID。

<notice>
若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
若无ID值，则无需传入。

</notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The push mode. Valid values:

ALL: pushes to all devices.

SINGLE_DEVICE: pushes to a single device.

GROUP_DEVICE: pushes to devices in a group
parameters.help_zh:
推送模式。

ALL：全量设备推送。

SINGLE_DEVICE：单设备推送。

GROUP_DEVICE：分组设备推送
parameters.name: push_mode

parameters.help_en:
The group ID. This parameter is required when PushMode is set to GROUP_DEVICE.
You can obtain the group ID from Device Management > Group Management
parameters.help_zh:
分组ID，当推送模式选择为分组设备时，该项必填。
您可以在设备管理 > 分组管理中获取分组ID，
parameters.name: group_id

parameters.help_en:
The device ID. When PushMode is set to SINGLE_DEVICE, you must specify either this parameter or the combination of ProductKey and DeviceName.

If you specify this parameter, you do not need to specify ProductKey or DeviceName. IotId is a globally unique identifier of a device and corresponds to a combination of ProductKey and DeviceName. If you specify both IotId and the combination of ProductKey and DeviceName, IotId takes precedence
parameters.help_zh:
设备ID。当推送模式选择为单个设备时，该参数与ProductKey、DeviceName组合二选一必传。

如果传入该参数，则无需传入ProductKey和DeviceName。IotId作为设备唯一标识符，和ProductKey与DeviceName组合是一一对应的关系。如果您同时传入IotId和ProductKey与DeviceName组合，则以IotId为准
parameters.name: iot_id

parameters.help_en: The project ID, which is the unique identifier of the project. You can obtain the project ID from the Project Management console (https://iot.console.aliyun.com/things-service/projects)
parameters.help_zh: 项目ID，是项目的唯一标识，您可以通过项目管理控制台 (https://iot.console.aliyun.com/things-service/projects)获取项目ID
parameters.name: project_code

parameters.help_en: The unique identifier of the product
parameters.name: product_key

parameters.help_en:
The list of speech corpus IDs to push. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/217576.html to obtain the IDs.

N is an integer. Valid values: 1 to 100. A maximum of 100 speech corpora can be pushed at a time
parameters.help_zh:
需要推送的语料ID列表。该参数可以通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/217576.html查询获取。

N为整数，取值范围：1~100，表示每次最多推送100条语料
parameters.name: speech_code_list

Code.description_en: The error code returned if the call fails. For more information, see [Error codes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87387.html）
Code.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的错误码。更多信息，请参见[错误码]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87387.html）

Data.description_en: The push task ID (JobCode), which is the unique identifier of the push task
Data.description_zh: 返回的推送任务ID（JobCode），是推送任务的唯一标识

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the call fails
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的错误信息
ErrorMessage.example: speech solution has not been signed

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call is successful. Valid values:

true: The call is successful.

false: The call fails
Success.description_zh:
是否调用成功。

true：调用成功。

false：调用失败
